_comment: Canonical User document shape. The Gateway is the authority: dbUserStore in internal/services/gateway/passkey_service.go creates and updates this document in the users collection of ztd.db. AuthService in internal/services/gateway/gateway_auth.go reads it for authentication and web session validation. A field mismatch breaks authentication and web session validation.
_comment.zero_pii: ZERO-PII ARCHITECTURE: This schema contains NO personally identifiable information. The platform persists only the public key (passkey credentials). Email and name are NOT stored - users are identified solely by their cryptographic credentials. Aligned with Go User struct (internal/models/auth.go).
_consumers: console (account and auth views, via gateway API responses)
_cache_aside: In-process sync.Map cache in AuthService (gateway_auth.go). The ztd.db users collection is the source of truth; there is no operator KV mirror.

user._description: Full user document as stored in client SQLite. Serialized from User (internal/models/auth.go).

id.description: Unique user identifier (UUID v4). Used as organization_id in single-user orgs.

webauthn_user_id.description: GUID for WebAuthn v4 compliance (Windows Hello). Omitted when empty.

organization_id.description: Organization this user belongs to. Equals user.id for single-user orgs. Omitted when empty.

roles.description: RBAC roles assigned to this user. Values: user, admin, owner, operator. Omitted when empty.

status.description: User account status. See status.json user.status. Omitted when empty.

is_bootstrap.description: Identifies the ephemeral local-owner identity created by ./ztd gw start -a over loopback. Not a privilege tier - marks an identity retired automatically on first real mTLS login. Omitted when false.

provider.description: Authentication provider. passkey = FIDO2/WebAuthn passwordless. Omitted when empty.

passkey_credentials.description: Registered FIDO2/WebAuthn passkey credentials. Each entry conforms to passkey_credential.json shape. Stored as encrypted JSON array. Never exposed to clients. Omitted when empty.

local_os_user.description: Local OS user account information. Conforms to local_os_user.json shape. Omitted when not set.
